metadata.title: The Nanny Who Owned The Mansion
metadata.subtitle: I went undercover as a nanny to investigate my sister's death—and uncovered a DNA twist that shattered the whole estate.

nodes.text: 8:00 PM · Blackwood Estate. Three weeks after going undercover as a live-in nanny to protect your late sister’s six-year-old son, Vivian storms into your room.
Search the nanny’s suitcase, Gideon! My late stepdaughter’s $50,000 heirloom ring vanished from my vanity!
I haven’t stepped near your bedroom all day, Mrs. Vivian. I was tutoring little Leo.
Found it, Madam! Tucked right inside her coat pocket!
Perfect—plant it deep so the police haul her out before she finds Leo’s real trust papers.

nodes.prompt: Vivian raises her hand to slap you in front of little Leo:

options.label: Catch her wrist & point to the smoke detector
options.player_reply_text: Careful, Vivian. You forgot I upgraded the nursery security last week.

options.label: Signal Liam to pull the estate CCTV log

nodes.text: You grip her wrist steadily. Gideon freezes as he notices the tiny crimson lens blinking above the doorframe.
How dare a servant touch me! That ring has my family’s crest—call the police!
Liam instantly beams the hallway clip to your phone: Gideon slipping the ring into your coat ten minutes ago!
Got them on HD, {{player_name}}. Ready to reveal who actually owns Blackwood Estate?
Little Leo hugs your leg tightly as Vivian sneers, waving a printed eviction notice.
Pack your rags! Tomorrow the court names MY son the sole heir to Blackwood—and Leo goes to boarding school!

nodes.headline: The Stolen Crest
nodes.teaser_text: Vivian thinks she’s kicking out a penniless nanny—she has no idea you are the sister’s billionaire twin who holds the master deed.

nodes.text: 8:15 PM · You step into the dark conservatory while Liam calls on your encrypted earpiece.
Liam speaks urgently: "{{player_name}}, look inside the ring Gideon planted—your sister hid a micro-engraving inside the band!"
Encrypted text pops up: "Check the inner band of the ring! Your sister left a vault code before she died."
Wait... why would Vivian plant my sister’s real ring if she knew there was a code inside?

nodes.caption: Close-up of the gold heirloom band — micro-engraved with the Swiss escrow cipher.

nodes.prompt: Gideon’s footsteps echo down the conservatory corridor:

options.label: Slip into the shadows & listen
options.player_reply_text: Let’s hear what Gideon and Vivian are whispering about.

options.label: Unlock the study safe with the ring code

nodes.text: Through the glass ferns, you hear Gideon hiss at Vivian: "If they run a DNA test tomorrow, our son loses everything!"
OUR son?! Vivian’s "heir" isn’t even my late brother-in-law’s child—he’s the butler’s son!!
You punch the 6-digit cipher into the study wall safe. It clicks open—revealing your sister’s original Will and a hospital swab!
Jackpot! That’s the original bloodline clause—and a backup CCTV drive from the night your sister fell!
Suddenly the conservatory lights blaze on. Gideon stands in the doorway holding a heavy brass poker.
You’re far too nosy for a nanny, {{player_name}}. Hand over that ring before you join your sister.

nodes.headline: Confession In The Dark
nodes.teaser_text: Gideon just admitted your sister’s death wasn’t an accident—and he thinks you’re trapped alone.

nodes.text: 8:28 PM · Gideon lunges forward—but you sidestep smoothly and trigger the panic latch on your watch.
Did you really think I walked into Blackwood Mansion without six bodyguards parked outside the gate?
Bodyguards?! Who the hell ARE you?!

nodes.transcript: [over intercom] "Perimeter breached by security team! Gideon, drop the iron bar—police are five minutes out!"

nodes.text: Gideon, burn the nanny’s phone before she uploads what she heard!

nodes.prompt: Gideon bolts toward the library fireplace to burn the estate ledger:

options.label: Lock the library doors remotely
options.player_reply_text: Smart-home override: lock all ground-floor doors.

options.label: Upload the backup CCTV to the police live

nodes.text: Heavy mahogany doors slam shut with a metallic click, trapping Gideon right inside the library.
Wait... ONLY the registered mansion owner has the smart-home override!!
The hidden footage streams straight to the homicide desk—showing Vivian and Gideon tampering with the balcony rail!
Homicide confirmed! The captain just upgraded this to a murder warrant!
Vivian storms down the grand staircase—only to freeze as your private security team lines the foyer.
What is happening in MY house?! Guards, arrest this thief!

nodes.headline: Whose Mansion?
nodes.teaser_text: Vivian screams that she owns Blackwood—until you unpin your hair and show her the deed she never knew existed.

nodes.text: 8:40 PM · You pull off the plain glasses and nanny apron. Vivian staggers back three steps, gasping.
You... you’re Clara’s younger sister, {{player_name}}?! The billionaire art dealer from Zurich?!
Surprise, Vivian. And Blackwood Estate was NEVER in my brother-in-law’s name—I bought the mortgage five years ago to protect my sister.
Which means you’ve been squatting in {{player_name}}’s house—and trying to steal her nephew’s trust.
No matter who owns the house, the family trust still goes to my son tomorrow!

nodes.prompt: Vivian insists the $60M family trust belongs to her son:

options.label: Reveal what you heard in the conservatory
options.player_reply_text: Your son isn’t a Blackwood, Vivian. He’s Gideon’s.

options.label: Play the audio of Gideon claiming his son

nodes.text: Vivian’s manicured nails dig into the banister as every servant in the foyer gasps.
Lies! Slander! You have zero proof—I’ll sue you for defamation!
You press play. Gideon’s panicked voice echoes through the marble foyer: "If they run a DNA test tomorrow, our son loses everything!"
Turn that off!! That’s AI-generated! I demand a real court test!
Blue and red police lights sweep across the mansion windows. Liam steps up with a sealed lab envelope.
No need to wait for tomorrow, Vivian. The certified DNA results just arrived from the forensic lab.

nodes.headline: The Forensic Verdict
nodes.teaser_text: The lab envelope proves Vivian’s son is a fraud—and reveals an even bigger secret about little Leo.

nodes.text: 8:55 PM · Police captains and estate trustees gather in the grand foyer as Liam breaks the forensic seal.
Sample A (Vivian’s son): 0.00% Blackwood match, 99.99% match to Head Butler Gideon.
And Sample B—little Leo—is 99.99% the sole legitimate heir to the entire Blackwood fortune.

nodes.caption: Forensic DNA Report: Vivian’s son excluded (0.00%); Leo confirmed sole legitimate heir.

nodes.text: Vivian, don’t tell them about the balcony rail—just take the fraud charge!

nodes.prompt: Vivian collapses onto the marble steps sobbing:

options.label: Hand the balcony CCTV to the homicide captain
options.player_reply_text: Fraud is the least of your worries, Vivian. Officer, play the balcony footage.

options.label: Play the balcony clip in front of Gideon

nodes.text: The police captain’s expression hardens as he watches the hidden clip on Liam’s tablet.
First-degree murder conspiracy confirmed. Cuff them both immediately!
Gideon sees himself on screen loosening the bronze bolts—and instantly turns on Vivian in terror!
It was Vivian’s idea!! She paid me $500,000 to cut the bolts so Clara would fall!
Vivian shrieks as steel handcuffs snap around her wrists. For the first time in a year, justice breathes inside Blackwood Mansion.
My sister can finally rest in peace.

nodes.headline: Justice For Clara
nodes.teaser_text: Vivian and Gideon are hauled away—but the estate’s crooked probate lawyer is still trying to freeze Leo’s trust.

nodes.text: 9:30 PM · Just as you tuck little Leo into bed, your phone flashes with an emergency bank alert.
Liam breathes hard: "Vivian’s probate lawyer just filed an overnight injunction to drain $15M from Leo’s Swiss account!"
Urgent alert: "Crooked probate attorney attempting $15M midnight drain on Leo’s escrow!"
Good thing my sister engraved the master Swiss cipher inside her ring. Read me the bank’s verification code!

nodes.transcript: [rapid typing] "Entering your ring cipher now... override accepted! The $15M wire is blocked and the attorney’s credentials are flagged!"

nodes.prompt: The crooked lawyer begs to settle privately:

options.label: Disbar him & hand his files to prosecutors
options.player_reply_text: Zero deals with anyone who steals from a six-year-old.

options.label: Trace his offshore accounts for stolen assets

nodes.text: Liam files the disbarment petition and criminal referral before midnight.
Police just picked him up at the airport! Leo’s entire $60M trust is 100% intact!
Your Zurich forensic accountants trace three hidden shell accounts—recovering $8 million more that Vivian siphoned last year!
Incredible! Every single cent stolen from your sister’s estate is coming back to Leo!
You glance through the nursery doorway. Little Leo is sleeping peacefully, clutching his mother’s old teddy bear.
Sleep tight, little man. Nobody will ever hurt you again.

nodes.headline: The Probate Hearing
nodes.teaser_text: Tomorrow morning the judge decides Leo’s permanent guardian—and one last surprise waits in your sister’s final letter.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · Family Court. The judge bangs the gavel, granting you sole guardianship of Leo and full trusteeship of Blackwood.
Congratulations, {{player_name}}. Also, the court clerk found a sealed letter from your sister inside the original will.
A letter for me? Open it—please.

nodes.transcript: [reading softly] "Dearest {{player_name}}, if anything happens to me, I know you’ll come in disguise to protect Leo. Wear my ring with pride."

nodes.text: I kept my promise, sis. Every single one of them is paying.

nodes.prompt: Outside the courthouse, reporters swarm for a quote:

options.label: Shield Leo & step quietly into the car
options.player_reply_text: No comment today. My nephew comes first.

nodes.text: You lift Leo onto your hip and step smoothly into the waiting armored sedan.
Pure class, {{player_name}}. Leo hasn’t stopped smiling all morning.
You pause on the steps and pledge $10M to protect orphaned children and fund legal aid in your sister’s name.
The whole city is cheering your sister’s legacy tonight!
Back at Blackwood Mansion, the dark heavy drapes are thrown open for the first time in years.
One last call from the prison warden—Vivian begged to speak with you before sentencing.

nodes.headline: The Final Reckoning
nodes.teaser_text: Will you face Vivian behind prison glass, or leave her to fade into obscurity?

nodes.text: 2:00 PM · County Detention Center. Vivian sits in an orange jumpsuit, her designer glamour completely gone.
Please, {{player_name}}... my son is innocent! He didn’t know Gideon was his father! Don’t leave him on the street!
Unlike you, Vivian, I don’t punish children for their parents’ crimes. I already paid for his college tuition—far away from Blackwood.

nodes.transcript: [breaking down in tears] "You’re a better person than I ever was... I’m sorry for what I did to Clara."

nodes.text: The prosecutor confirmed life without parole for both Vivian and Gideon.

nodes.prompt: You set the prison receiver back on the hook:

options.label: Leave her the nanny apron as a reminder

nodes.text: You step out into the bright afternoon sun, leaving the darkness of the past behind forever.
Time to go home to Leo.
You smile faintly as the guard files the folded apron away—the humble disguise that brought down a murderer.
Best undercover operation I’ve ever witnessed, {{player_name}}.
Your car winds up the oak-lined drive back toward a sunlit, reborn Blackwood Estate.
Wait till you see what Leo painted for you in the garden!

nodes.headline: Sunlight Returns
nodes.teaser_text: One final afternoon in the garden brings the healing your family waited years for.

nodes.text: 5:00 PM · Blackwood Rose Garden. Leo runs across the grass holding a bright watercolor painting of you wearing a golden crown.
He titled it "My Nanny Queen." Not a dry eye on the estate staff!
I’ve owned $10M masterpieces in Zurich, and none of them comes close to this.

nodes.transcript: [warm smile] "All new honest staff hired, trust secured for generations, and Blackwood is finally a real home."

nodes.text: Thank you for watching over us, Clara.

nodes.prompt: How do you celebrate your first evening as official owners?

options.label: Hang Leo’s painting in the grand foyer
options.player_reply_text: Right in the center of the foyer—where everyone sees it!

options.label: Throw a garden barbecue for the whole staff

nodes.text: Leo beams proudly as his watercolor takes the place of honor above the grand marble hearth.
Best artwork in Blackwood history.
String lights twinkle across the rose garden as laughter fills Blackwood Mansion for the first time in years.
Here’s to a brand-new chapter, {{player_name}}!
Your sister’s gold ring gleams gently on your finger as the evening breeze sweeps across the rose garden.
Welcome home, Madam {{player_name}}.

nodes.headline: Finale · The Nanny Queen
nodes.teaser_text: The murderers are behind bars, the fake heir is exposed, and Leo grows up safe in the arms of the aunt who owns the mansion.
